SOUND

Game sounds: little blips and chimes when pieces move, lock, and clear. No music — just the sounds of the game.

CONTROLS

PLAY WITH — PICK ONE

BOTH mode: keyboard and the on-screen buttons are all live — mix them however you like.

⌨ KEYBOARD
← → Arrow keysMove the piece left and right
↓ Arrow key (hold)Soft drop — the piece falls fast while you hold it, and scores 1 point per row
↑ Arrow key or XRotate right (clockwise)
ZRotate left (counter-clockwise)
PPause / keep playing
EscClose this window
🖱 MOUSE

Play with the big buttons under the board — every one is labeled with a word, so there's nothing to guess.

◀ LEFT · RIGHT ▶Click to nudge the piece; press and hold to keep sliding
ROTATEClick to turn the piece
▼ SOFT DROPPress and hold — the piece falls fast; let go and it floats again
⏸ PAUSEClick to pause / keep playing
👆 TOUCH (ON THE BOARD)
Drag sidewaysSlide the piece left and right
Tap the boardRotate the piece
Press & hold, or drag downSoft drop — fast fall while you hold; let go and it floats again
⏸ PAUSE buttonThe button under the board pauses the game

That's the whole machine — just like the original. No hold box, no ghost outline, no slam drop. Your eyes, your hands, and the NEXT box.

HOW TO PLAY — THE KEYS

Tetris is pattern recognition under a ticking clock. These seven keys are how good players think — learn them here, then go use them on the board.
